qualifications: Archive carries producer-reported binary/lock identity; raw executable/lock bytes absent and not independently rehashed in this audit.
Whole-script final whole-bench and per-vessel represented material/formal-charge accounting; no energy or per-step closure claim.
Exact-source registry compositions and OH-derived base_equivalents; no double-counting of solution distributions, measured H/OH fields, lots or solute_charge.
RX008 only the warm acidic curated endpoint; missing acid/temperature gates and MnII spectrum do not become calibrated kinetics/heat.
RX010/011 ideal open-circuit Nernst measurements, with no discharge, junction-potential or empirical electrode claim.
RX013/014 ideal imposed-current model; floating extraction residuals are arithmetic checks, not newly authored physical acceptance tolerances.
RX012 original opposite-sign forecast fails; source sorts physical anode/cathode and reports positive spontaneous magnitude. No expectation rewrite.
RX006/007 positive literal curated conversion does not close unsupported KI/iodine-mixture and dissolution coverage.
